deliverables: XDP_BUDGET_CFG (Array x1, XdpBudgetConfig 72B): unverified_pps / new_flow_per_sec / xsk_redirect_pps / challenge_pps / verified_pps / control_pps / service_flow_pps / window_ns / flags (bit0-6 enforce bits)

XDP_BUDGET (PerCpuArray x1, XdpBudgetBucket 96B, six dims): per-CPU fixed-window buckets; userspace pre-divides node totals by possible-CPU count (ceil, floor 1) so quota never multiplies with CPU/queue count

dim0 unverified at handle stage (all modes, after ACL, before source buckets); dim1 new-flow before CT/SNAT insert on all 4 NAT admission paths (udp4/tcp4/udp6_fwd/tcp6_fwd); dim2 xsk-redirect at AF_XDP redirect; dim4 verified packets on CT-hit paths; dim5 control (ICMP/ND/PMTU)
verified pool is exclusive: CT-hit / SNAT_REV-hit traffic charges dim4 and refunds dim0 — an unverified flood can never starve established flows

ABI v13: XdpSvcBucket (16B) + XDP_SVC_BUDGET (PerCpuHashMap u32->bucket, 256 entries) keyed by listen dst-port; dim6 gate after aggregate dim1 on every new-flow admission path — a distributed flood on one service cannot drain sibling services' share
service map capacity exhaustion is bounded and observable: insert failure counts svcBudgetFull and the packet still passes/fails on the aggregate dim1 envelope — never a silent bypass
missing dim1 charges added on IPv6 NAT admission paths (udp6_fwd, tcp6_fwd, and the v6 reply-side fresh-admission sites) so v4/v6 are symmetric

xdp.budget config gains verifiedPps/xskRedirectPps/controlPps/serviceFlowPps; serviceFlowPps defaults to newFlowPerSec (single-service nodes see no behavior change)
